goal: Capture current production and approved-prototype evidence proving the shared shell remains equivalent in dark/light desktop and 390px mobile states before route-family implementation.
non_goals: Do not redesign route-family pages or claim route-family parity.
Do not change APIs, stores, router behavior, authentication, permission calculation, persistence, backend code, dependencies, or the approved prototype.
Do not add a second shell, token system, comparison harness, or prototype fixture to production.
Do not modify an allowed production file unless a rendered, reproducible requirement delta is observed.
expected_evidence: Rendered production and approved-prototype screenshots for dark/light at 1600x1000 and 390x844.
Computed measurements for sidebar, topbar, brand, navigation density, colors, theme attributes, and page overflow.
Mobile drawer evidence for closed/open state, backdrop, ARIA, focus entry/return, inert background, scroll lock, and Escape close.
Focused shell Vitest plus full Vitest, targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, and git diff output.
Evidence-bearing task report plus independent spec and quality reviews covering A2 and A3 within shared-shell scope.
unsafe_assumptions: Earlier browser evidence does not prove the current committed shell snapshot.
Source token equality does not prove computed geometry, readability, overflow, or interaction.
Visual comparison is invalid unless theme, locale, viewport, permission role, and populated-data state are equivalent.
Pixel identity is not required when hierarchy, density, behavior, and semantic tokens satisfy the approved contract.
stop_condition: Stop before production edits if the pages cannot be rendered in equivalent states, or if a measured defect requires changes outside the twelve allowed production/test files.
